product: TEC EPR Clinic Edition 1.0.1 and TCL commercial gateway
scopeNote: Engineering evidence inventory. Not a HIPAA/GDPR certificate, regulatory clearance or approval of clinical use.

controls.scope: Verified email, PKCE and server-side short-lived sessions; gateway only
Appointed gateway administrators require recent MFA
Gateway grant/membership and cross-tenant download controls
CSRF, exact origin, bounded inputs, duplicate protection, identity-wide quota
New request creation, export and status-change audit; transactional rollback; not immutable offsite audit storage
Own commercial requests only; pagination; not a complete patient or WorkOS subject-access response
Pinned archive identity and private expiring downloads; independently signed release retained
One installation; does not validate every clinical module
Named qualified clinical safety officer, hazard log review, clinical safety case and intended-use approval
Function-by-function UK/EU/US and intended-market qualification/classification including AI and laboratory decision functions
Deployment-specific complete ePHI data map, risk assessment, policies, workforce training and BAA applicability
Controller/processor roles, lawful bases, Article 9 condition, DPIA, DPA, retention, rights, transfers and breach procedure
Verify customer host encryption, backup encryption, restore, RPO/RTO and privileged support access per deployment
Independent scoped security report and remediation retest; source tests are not a penetration test
Verify Cloudflare WAF, bot/rate rules, TLS and alert routing using actual account access

evidence: Read-only Stripe review 2026-11-17: active Tax settings, no registrations, inconsistent head-office country/address; owner states UK VAT and Jamaica GCT registered
controls.scope: Confirm legal seller/head office and registrations; confirm product tax codes and Jamaica tax support; no tax collection asserted

evidence: Read-only Stripe price search 2026-11-17 returned no active prices
controls.scope: Approved prices, isolated sandbox, authenticated Checkout, verified idempotent webhooks, cancellations/refunds and tax tests
Protected separate signer and issuance ledger; no private key in gateway or customer package
Approved EULA, subscription/support terms, trial restrictions, refund terms and perpetual licence scope
Illustrated role-specific user/admin documentation validated against exact released UI
